name: The doomed plane
aliases: a plane whose name is lost to history
description: A plane whose name is lost to history, more than 6,000 years ago, where Nahiri and Sorin defend refugees until it is unraveled by the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises a stone rampart around a refugee camp, though she knows it will not hold against the monstrous creatures overrunning the plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, called the Lithomancer, surveyed her work and frowned.
